g.text: BENCH REVIEW ONLY - NO HUMAN / FABRICATION RELEASE

g.desc: BENCH REVIEW ONLY - NO HUMAN / FABRICATION RELEASE

g.text: RLDOUT / RLDINV -> U1 pins 63 / 61. RLDREF pin 60 open requires internal midsupply selection.

g.desc: RLDOUT / RLDINV -> U1 pins 63 / 61. RLDREF pin 60 open requires internal midsupply selection.

g.text: A4S bring-up: RLD initially OFF; dummy loads only. Then use CH1 pair only: SENSP=01, SENSN=01.

g.desc: A4S bring-up: RLD initially OFF; dummy loads only. Then use CH1 pair only: SENSP=01, SENSN=01.

g.text: No automatic multi-pair selection: 1F/1F or 3F/3F requires a separate real-load stability review.

g.desc: No automatic multi-pair selection: 1F/1F or 3F/3F requires a separate real-load stability review.

g.text: Recording six channels does NOT require six pairs in RLD. 1M || 1n5 is not a stability guarantee.

g.desc: Recording six channels does NOT require six pairs in RLD. 1M || 1n5 is not a stability guarantee.

g.text: R22 + R23 = 220k. Current limiting here is NOT an isolation barrier or safety certification.

g.desc: R22 + R23 = 220k. Current limiting here is NOT an isolation barrier or safety certification.

g.text: Bench verification: no person connected; dummy electrode impedances and realistic cable capacitance.

g.desc: Bench verification: no person connected; dummy electrode impedances and realistic cable capacitance.

g.text: Do not connect an earthed oscilloscope, signal generator, debugger or charger to a worn assembly.

g.desc: Do not connect an earthed oscilloscope, signal generator, debugger or charger to a worn assembly.

g.text: The board has no on-board galvanic isolation. Use a reviewed external USB isolation/power arrangement.

g.desc: The board has no on-board galvanic isolation. Use a reviewed external USB isolation/power arrangement.
